The '''Dubloviann system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] regions.<ref name="Region" /> It was the origin point of the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] known as the [[Dubloviann flame rifle]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dubloviann flame rifle]]|system=Dubloviann [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dubloviann [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-8.<ref name="TEA" />
